create_State_instance: create a State instance with invocation metadata, requests list, and requests closed flag
send_response_to_client: send a response to the client by appending it to the State responses queue
terminate_RPC_call: terminate an RPC call with trailing metadata, status code, and details message
cancel_RPC_call: cancel an active RPC call by setting a status code and details on the State
take_invocation_metadata_and_request: take the invocation metadata and first request from the State in a single atomic operation
